title: AC-8 sixth prompt cannot route to feature-development under NFR-1
context: AC-8 requires 'develop only issue 830 and create one generic branch where we later add 829 and 830 issue' to route feature-development. NFR-1 says cause 1 makes no change to the other pre-classifier checks. Measured with the cause 1 token rules in place: isCreateArtifactAsk is now false, hasCodeNegation and isAboutWorkPrompt are false, but isQuestionRoute is true, because 'where' is in QUESTION_ANYWHERE_LEADS and a leading 'develop' is not in CODE_VERBS, so resolveWorkflow returns project-question. The word 'where' came from the spec spelling out the issue's elided row (the issue shows '… create one generic branch … 829 and 830 issue'), so the plan's measurement that isQuestionRoute is false for every row did not cover it. The same prompt without 'where' routes feature-development, and the other six AC-8 prompts and the AC-1 prompt already pass. Both AC-8 and NFR-1 cannot hold as written.

options.label: Keep AC-8 verbatim. Widen NFR-1 by one local rule: a message starting with develop or develops is not read as a question, as add and fix are today. Any develop-led prompt with where, how, why or a trailing question mark then stops being a question
